item.title: Cossmass Infinities Podcast (2010)
item.description: The first incarnation of Cossmass Infinities was as an 11 episode Creative Commons Audio Podcast released in 2010. Fluff and Buttons on the Teddy Bear Range by Matthew Sanborn Smith The Strange Affair of the Martian Engine by Joshua Reynolds Suicide is Painless by Don Norum Our Father's Eyes by Georgina Kamsika Half-Breed by Jo Thomas How You Make The Straight by R J Astruc Early Edition by Don Norum Sister of the Benevolent Gods by Ripley Patton Under A Closed Sky by Colum Paget 10% by Edward W
